No stranger to sending it big as well as getting creative, Alex never stops. His ambition spurs him on to compete at the highest level, while filming more segments than anyone else, from the park to the streets to the backcountry. Alex recently cemented his legendary status with a gold medal in Slopestyle at the 2022 Winter Olympics. 2022 Olympic Gold Medalist: Slopestyle 6x X-Games medalist, 2x Gold First skier to land a 2160 in competition MAGMA film production What does Alex Hall Ride?
